verdict.why: After a successful pages deploy or project create with --force, wrangler now prints an extra notice.

draft.detail: When an AI agent opts out by passing --force to wrangler pages project create, Wrangler now prints a notice that --force only needs to be passed once

test.error: FAIL: no notice that --force is only needed once after a successful pages project create --force

source.quote: When an AI agent opts out of the Pages-to-Workers delegation by passing `--force` to `wrangler pages deploy` or `wrangler pages project create`, Wrangler now prints a notice at the end of a successful command explaining that `--force` only needs to be passed once
